name: Part of the Praya Manduco, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A view of houses and figures near the shore of the Inner Harbour, Macau, with the convent on the summit of Penha Hill above. The small bay is marked by the modern-day 'Praya do Manduco' ('Hawker Street'). For a view of the same subject taken a year before see E.1733-1928.
